body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> LG Electronics launched ‘Super Multi Blue’ that supports both Blu-ray and HD-DVD formats. It can read/write Blu-ray whereas it can read HD-DVD format.
